## Summary

<!--
What changed, why it changed, and the main user, architecture, or correctness effect.
A short Before/After works well. Do not restate the commit list.
-->

## Related issues

<!--
Link the issue(s). Use "Closes" only when this PR fully resolves the issue;
partial roadmap slices and parked drafts should use "Refs".
  Closes #123
  Refs #456
-->

## Scope / non-goals

<!--
Optional. State meaningful boundaries when useful, e.g. which roadmap phase/slice
this implements and what is deliberately left for later. Delete if not needed.
-->

## Validation

<!--
List the checks you actually ran and their results, e.g. focused unit tests,
full unit/Test Gate, Ruff, Pyright, invariants, affected or full E2E,
build/dependency checks. Run what fits the change; say briefly why a relevant
check was skipped. Do not copy CI status here.
-->

## UI evidence

<!--
Optional: only when visible UI changed. Name the route/surface and add
screenshots or brief evidence. Delete for non-UI PRs.
-->

## Migration / compatibility impact

<!--
Optional: only when applicable. Mention schema migration, API/OpenAPI change,
data/storage migration, config/default change, or backward-compatibility impact
(including an intentional break). Delete if none.
-->

## Risks / follow-up

<!--
Known risks, deferred work, and follow-up issue/phase references. Delete if none.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks were run and are listed above.
- [ ] Documentation/generated files were updated when required.
- [ ] UI evidence is included when applicable.
- [ ] No unrelated changes are intentionally included.
